items.name: 1. Spec Compliance
items.note: AC02/AC05 closed with coded artifacts (release.py) + E2E CLI tests. Refusal is structural (shared test_gate.py oracle); auto-rollback is a coded trigger, not agent prose.

items.name: 2. Error Handling
items.note: Found+fixed during self-review: the auto-rollback path called rollback_audit.record without rollback.py main()'s own LockTimeout/OSError -> record_degraded fallback. Mirrored it, added a regression test.

items.name: 3. Security Basics
items.note: No new raw HTTP calls, no new secret handling, token flow untouched.

items.name: 4. Test Quality
items.note: Outcome-based (host call log, JSON result, audit file contents); one happy + one error/edge path per branch.

items.name: 5. Performance Basics
items.note: No new loops; reuses existing smoke-poll/rollback mechanics unchanged.

items.name: 6. Naming & Structure
items.note: Private helpers mirror rollback.py's own; one shared test-gate oracle instead of two independently-maintained copies.

items.name: 7. Affected Boundaries
items.note: Reads/writes existing JSON boundary files via already-tested functions; no new format; no risk flag fired (diff-driven file-path detector confirmed no io_boundary/cross_component paths touched).
